Moving parts — walking between two stations

A part walks from the entrance to each station in turn, and out again.

What to watch for

The dots on the grey lines are parts in transit, interpolated along the straight line between the coordinates each move reported. The lines themselves were not drawn by hand: they are the routes parts actually took, read off the trace.

Underneath

This is a real run of a real model, not a recording. The page fetched the trace (17 KB gzipped) and drew it through the same renderer the desktop animation application uses. Download it and open it there to lay it out yourself.

Read the model's source — the simulation is not modified to be animated; capture is a flag on a run.
